summary.text: Will Darby is a Democratic state representative from New Hampshire House District Hillsborough 11 who has served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Darby described himself as the deputy ranking member of the Resources, Recreation and Development committee and a software manager and engineer at Arista Networks in Nashua.

paragraphs.text: William "Will" Darby lives in Nashua, New Hampshire, and earned a high school diploma from Essex High School.
He received a B.S. in computer science/computer engineering from Clarkson University in 1993 and an M.S. in computer science from Villanova University in 1997.

Ballotpedia lists his career experience as software engineer and manager with Arista Networks, chief information strategist with Lee River Proprietary Strategies, and principal software/systems engineer with MITRE.
Darby was first elected to the New Hampshire House in 2022 and was assigned to the Resources, Recreation and Development Committee for the 2023-2024 session.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he named the cost of living, property taxes, housing development and electricity costs as campaign messages, and said he is passionate about preserving the environment.
